messages:
anya: Quick ping 1 - hitting an SSE streaming edge in the onboarding sample. If the network drops mid-logical-message, EventSource resumes with Last-Event-ID but the client sometimes sees duplicated tail fragments or missing suffixes and JSON parse fails.

lee: Browser or node sample? minimal repro?

anya: Both. Browser EventSource + node stream. Repro: 1) stream a logical JSON split across 2+ chunks 2) force a disconnect during the second chunk 3) reconnect using Last-Event-ID. Sometimes final bytes are replayed as a separate fragment and client concatenates twice or drops them.

lee: Hmm. That screams resume token being advanced on fragment emission rather than logical-message completion. Do you have a tiny console log?

anya: snippet: 
received id=42 chunk="{\"msg\":\"He\""
received id=43 chunk="{\"msg\":\"llo\""
// drop here
reconnect Last-Event-ID=43
received id=43 chunk="\" world\""
received id=44 chunk="{\"msg\":\"Bye\"}"

anya: Depending on timing, you get 43+43' or 43' merged into 44 -> invalid JSON.

ops-bot: Created ticket TKT-4031: "sse: resume semantics should map to logical messages, not raw fragments" and attached logs.

lee: Short-term mitigation: sample-app should dedupe resumed fragments by tracking last-fragment hash per event id. Not pretty, but stabilizes onboarding. Long-term: runtime should emit explicit logical-boundary markers or only advance resume token when full message is flushed.

anya: Will push small patch to sample-app with dedupe helper + README note about SDK parity differences. Also adding a headless network-flap test behind an env flag.

lee: Sweet. Add an inline comment in the helper pointing to TKT-4031 so we remember to remove it later.

anya: Pushed change and added tests. Marking for follow-up when runtime ETA is available. :thumbsup:
